_comment: WHERE TO ASK WHICH JURISDICTION A PARCEL IS IN (review-audit draft 09), as per-county DATA: loaded by backend/src/parcelJurisdiction.ts. One record per county public parcel / city-limits service. The service is asked by address, as a background job only (never on a page read), and ONLY when queryUrl is on a government host (shared/src/officialSource.isOfficialSourceHost: .gov, .mil, a .xx.us locality or state, a .gov.xx) — a record on any other host is dropped at load. The answer is cached by a hash of the address (parcel_jurisdiction_checks). FIELDS: state (two letters); county (the county as an agency name, e.g. 'Example County'); covers.cities / covers.zips (the mailing cities and ZIP codes whose addresses this county's service is asked about; a mailing city can sit in more than one county, list it on each); queryUrl (https, with placeholders {street} {houseNumber} {streetName} {city} {zip} {state}, each SQL-quote-escaped and URL-encoded; an ArcGIS feature query is the common shape: .../query?where=SITE_ADDR%3D%27{street}%27&outFields=CITY&returnGeometry=false&f=json); recordsPath (dot path to the array of matches, '' = the whole answer is one match); jurisdictionField (dot path inside one match to the city / jurisdiction value); unincorporatedValues (values, case-insensitive, that mean the parcel is in the unincorporated county; include '' only if the service leaves the field blank for county parcels); cityNames (optional map from a raw value to the city's name, e.g. 'MER' -> 'Meridian'); addressStyle ('usps' = 'North Main Street' is sent as 'N MAIN ST', the default; 'full' = sent as written, upper-cased). TIER: 'seeded' (the default), 'official' (honoured only when sourceUrl is on a government host, quote names the service's host and fetchedAt is set; else read as seeded) or 'verified' (honoured only with verifiedBy, a named person). A parcel that disagrees with the project AHJ is a BLOCKER on permit tracks only when the record is verified or official, or names its source (sourceName + http(s) sourceUrl) and quotes it with words that name the service's host (Helm's #637 bar); otherwise it is a WARNING. HOSTED MAP PLATFORM (draft 16 B; owner 2026-11-10): a county whose parcel map is on ArcGIS Online (*.arcgis.com, run by Esri, never a government host) may be listed ONLY as a person-verified record: tier 'verified' with verifiedBy (the person who checked); sourceUrl = the county's own page on a GOVERNMENT host; pageLinksHost = the *.arcgis.com host that page links (defaults to the service host); quote = the page's words naming pageLinksHost, verbatim; fetchedAt; and verifiedService = the exact https service root the person followed the link to, with its path (e.g. https://servicesN.arcgis.com/<org id>/arcgis/rest/services/<name>/FeatureServer). queryUrl must sit under verifiedService, and only that root is ever asked. A seeded or official ArcGIS record, one off a government source page, and any other third-party host are dropped at load. Only the address the template asks for (street, city / ZIP) is sent there. To add a county, add a record here: no code. Every value must come from the county's own page, quoted verbatim.
